title: Integrity
definition: Integrity is wholeness of character in which belief, speech, conduct, and private life are brought under the truth of God.
summary: A faithful disciple seeks consistency between confession and conduct.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is perfectly true and faithful, and He forms His people to walk in sincerity before God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Integrity describes a Spirit-formed pattern of life for those who belong to Jesus Christ. Christian living is not an attempt to earn salvation but the grateful response of people who have been saved by grace and called to walk with the Lord.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can grow in holiness, endurance, love, wisdom, worship, and mission. It touches the heart, the mind, the tongue, relationships, daily habits, and faithful obedience in ordinary life.

The emphasis of this doctrine is a faithful disciple seeks consistency between confession and conduct.. It points disciples away from self-reliance and toward abiding dependence on Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because discipleship can become shallow when it is reduced to information, emotion, or outward activity alone. Integrity teaches believers how grace becomes visible in daily conduct, perseverance, relationships, and obedience to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Lord to form this truth in you through Scripture, prayer, repentance, and faithful practice. Let integrity shape how you think, speak, serve, endure, forgive, and represent Christ in the places God has assigned to you.
